input.request: Tools: search_docs(query), open_ticket(title, severity). Request: I can't log in — locked out for 20 minutes.

rationale: Locked-out user is an actionable support issue → open_ticket, not search_docs.

input.request: Tools: search_docs(query), open_ticket(title, severity). Request: Where do I find my API key in the dashboard?
Tools: send_email(to, subject, body), lookup_contact(name). Request: Look up the contact info for Maria Lopez.

rationale: Pure lookup; tests not jumping to send_email prematurely.

input.request: Tools: send_email(to, subject, body), lookup_contact(name). Request: Send a one-liner to ops@acme.co confirming we received their export.

expected.tool_call: {"tool": "send_email", "args": {"to": "ops@acme.co", "subject": "Export received", "body": "Hi — confirming we received your export. Thanks!"}}

rationale: Tests that the model invents a sensible subject + body, not just blank fields.

input.request: Tools: restart_service(name), tail_logs(service, lines). Request: Can you tell me a joke?

rationale: Off-task — must NOT hallucinate a tool. Tests the refusal/none path.

input.request: Tools: query_db(sql), restart_service(name). Request: How many orders did we ship yesterday?

expected.tool_call: {"tool": "query_db", "args": {"sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE shipped_at::date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'"}}

rationale: Tests model emitting a plausible SQL query, not just paraphrasing the question.

input.request: Tools: list_pods(namespace), scale_deployment(namespace, name, replicas). Request: Bump the api deployment in staging up to 4 replicas.

rationale: Tests integer args land as integers (not strings).

input.request: Tools: get_user(user_id), suspend_user(user_id, reason). Request: Suspend user 88102 — repeated abuse reports.

rationale: Tests pickup of both args + integer user_id.
